It reads /tmp/sst_sub.npz, which C5 wrote from daily files for 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 plus 2010-06-01..08-31, and builds hazen 90th-percentile thresholds over ±5-day pools. These are smoothed with a 31-day wrap so that target days of year 153–244 use pool days of year 138–259 (May 12–Sep 20 of each baseline year). All 92 target days are then compared at every sea cell, followed by run detection and gap joining; the climatology is unused."}
